SELECT a.id, a.title, a.slug, a.summary, a.cover_image, a.category_id, ac.name AS category_name, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.comment_count, a.word_count, a.reading_time, a.is_published, a.is_top, a.publish_time, a.create_time, a.update_time FROM articles a LEFT JOIN article_categories ac ON a.category_id = ac.id WHERE a.is_published = 1
AND MATCH(a.title, a.summary, a.content_markdown) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE)
ORDER BY a.is_top DESC, a.create_time DESC
